Files API as the user for models and outputs · run records and MLflow written by the app's service principal
Reads and files go through on behalf of the signed-in user, so Unity Catalog grants and masks apply per person.
The app's service principal can only write run records and read the engines. Jobs run as their owner or a service principal.
